status: Fixed in source; frozen publication pending
finding: authorizeRunnerPublicationTakeover persisted a digest-valid plan without taskId. Taskflow close included that protected evidence solely from its task-shaped filename, while the pre-commit protected-state validator correctly refuses filenames as authority. A legitimate close therefore rolled back with ATM_PROTECTED_STATE_EVIDENCE_FILE_MISSING_TASK_CONTEXT.
expectedBehavior: Every protected evidence producer must persist one semantic task identity. Close bundle assembly must include takeover evidence only when its payload taskId matches the closing task; legacy contextless diagnostics remain visible in the worktree but cannot be staged or committed by filename inference.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0359 taskflow close reached write-ready after runner publication f6ed90b5c, then rolled back because .atm/history/evidence/ATM-GOV-0359.runner-publication-takeover.json had schema atm.runnerPublicationTakeoverPlan.v1 but no taskId. The hook classified it as evidence-without-semantic-task-id/current-task. Focused regressions: runner-sync-framework-temp-hotfix.test.ts and current-task-close-evidence.spec.ts. Publication verified on 2026-08-14 against the runner's own declared input: release/atm-onefile/release-manifest.json at publication commit 8a3047111c7eb3673950ae719daed2801c151860 records sealedSourceCommit b3996c755027679acd995c4163fe96365f20468b with buildDecision fullRebuild and payloadReuse false, so the packed runner was rebuilt from that commit rather than reusing an earlier payload. This item cites no fix commit, so the commit was inferred rather than quoted: the last change to packages/core/src/broker/runner-build-output-inventory.ts, which is where runnerPublicationTakeoverPlan is produced, is f5b960660acf983e85db9e501d3c837956f7d6d9, an ancestor of the sealed source commit. Note that packages/core/dist is not tracked — core is bundled into the CLI dist and the onefile — so its absence from the published tree is not evidence either way. An inference is weaker evidence than a citation.
followUp: Publish the frozen runner, retry ATM-GOV-0359 close, and add a producer-consumer contract check covering all protected evidence schemas so task identity cannot be dropped between evidence generation, close bundle assembly, and pre-commit validation.
